cells.gaps: A May 2026 op-ed by the African Media Barometer rapporteur says the Act remains inoperative and its information commissioner unappointed (NAM-005, NAM-006). No commencement notice, decision on a request or published figures of requests have been found.
cells.note: The Act of 2022 is promulgated and regulations made under it in December 2024 answer question 3, so stage 4. Under message 130 question 4 needs the law operating: a rule made under it answers question 3 only. No decision, penalty or figures of requests are held, and in May 2026 the Act was reported inoperative.
